description: Critical bug fixes, UX improvements, and feature enhancements for CacheBash mobile app

userStories.title: Fix Push Notifications
userStories.description: As a user, I want to receive push notifications on my phone when Claude asks a question so that I can respond from anywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Push notifications are delivered to iOS devices
Push notifications are delivered to Android devices
High priority questions trigger immediate notifications
Notification contains enough context to understand the question
userStories.technicalNotes: Check FCM token registration, APNs configuration, and Cloud Function triggers. Verify the onQuestion Cloud Function is firing correctly.
userStories.notes: Fixed: onMessageCreate Cloud Function was not deployed. Added preview field for notification body (encrypted questions showed gibberish).

userStories.title: Add Real-Time Updates to Messages
userStories.description: As a user, I want messages to update in real-time so that I don't need to pull-to-refresh to see new questions from Claude.
acceptanceCriteria: New messages appear automatically without refresh
Message status changes (answered, expired) update in real-time
Uses Firestore listeners instead of one-time fetches
userStories.technicalNotes: Replace any one-time fetches in the messages provider with Firestore stream listeners.
userStories.notes: Refactored activeMessagesProvider to use stream-based merging. Both /messages and /questions collections now use Firestore .snapshots() listeners with combineLatest pattern.

userStories.title: Fix Sessions Not Appearing on Home Screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see my active Claude sessions on the home screen so that I can monitor progress at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Active sessions appear in Active Sessions section on home screen
Sessions show their most recent status update
Sessions update in real-time when Claude sends status updates
userStories.technicalNotes: Check the sessions query in the home screen - likely a filter or listener issue. Sessions may not be getting created or may have wrong state values.
userStories.notes: Fixed: MCP updateStatus was not setting archived: false, so sessions didn't match the isNotEqualTo: true query. Firestore isNotEqualTo doesn't match missing fields.

userStories.title: Fix Archive Error Document Not Found
userStories.description: As a user, I want to archive messages without seeing errors so that I can organize my inbox cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Archiving a message completes without error
Archived message disappears from inbox
Archived message appears in archive folder
userStories.technicalNotes: Error 'some requested document not found' suggests a batch operation or transaction is trying to access a non-existent document. Check the archive logic for race conditions or stale references.
userStories.notes: Fixed: MessagesService methods only tried /messages collection, but activeMessagesProvider merges both /messages and /questions. Updated archiveMessage, unarchiveMessage, and deleteMessage to check both collections.

userStories.title: Archived Messages Move to Archive Folder
userStories.description: As a user, I want archived messages to appear in an archive folder so that I can find them later if needed.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive folder/tab exists in the app
Archived messages appear in the archive view
Archived messages are filtered out of the main inbox
userStories.technicalNotes: Likely need to add an archive tab or filter to the messages screen, and update the Firestore query to filter by archived: true/false.
userStories.notes: Added ArchivedMessagesScreen accessible via archive icon in messages screen AppBar. Uses archivedMessagesProvider that streams from both /messages and /questions collections.

userStories.title: Session Cards Show Recent Updates
userStories.description: As a user, I want session cards to show the most recent status update so that I can see progress without tapping into each session.
acceptanceCriteria: Session card displays current status text
Session card shows last update timestamp
Session card reflects state (working, blocked, pinned, complete)
userStories.technicalNotes: The session model already has status, state, and lastUpdate fields - ensure the card widget displays them.
userStories.notes: Already implemented: SessionCard widget displays status text (lines 69-79), last update timestamp (lines 97-119), and state via colored icons (lines 205-242). Data flows correctly from MCP updateStatus → Firestore → SessionModel → SessionCard.

userStories.title: Click Session to See Previous Updates
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tap a session and see its history of status updates so that I can review what Claude has been working on.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping a session navigates to a detail view
Detail view shows list of status updates in chronological order
Each update shows timestamp and status text
userStories.technicalNotes: May need to store status history in a subcollection /sessions/{id}/updates or keep a list in the session document.
userStories.notes: Added /sessions/{id}/updates subcollection. MCP updateStatus writes history entries. Flutter sessionUpdatesProvider streams history. SessionDetailScreen displays history with state icons, status text, timestamps, and progress badges.

userStories.title: Add Project Identifier to Sessions
userStories.description: As a user, I want sessions to show which project/repo they belong to so that I can differentiate between multiple Claude terminals.
acceptanceCriteria: Session card shows project name
Project defaults to repo name (e.g., CacheBash)
Project can be set via MCP when creating/updating session
userStories.technicalNotes: Add projectId or projectName field to session. MCP server can pass this from the project field in ralph.config.json or detect from git remote.
userStories.notes: Added projectName to MCP update_status tool, SessionModel, and SessionCard. Project name is optional and displays with folder icon when set.

userStories.title: Swap Search and Sessions Icons
userStories.description: As a user, I want the navigation icons in a logical order so that frequently-used items are in convenient positions.
acceptanceCriteria: Sessions icon is swapped with search icon in bottom navigation
Navigation still functions correctly after swap
userStories.technicalNotes: Simple reorder in the bottom navigation widget.
userStories.notes: Swapped positions in main_shell.dart: Sessions now at position 4 (next to compose), Search at position 5. Updated selection indices accordingly.

userStories.title: Remove New Task Button
userStories.description: As a user, I don't need the + New Task button because tasks are created from the messages compose screen.
acceptanceCriteria: + New Task button is removed from the UI
Task creation still works through compose message flow
userStories.technicalNotes: Remove the FAB or button from wherever it appears.
userStories.notes: Removed FAB and empty state button from TasksScreen. Task creation works via /messages/new (CreateMessageScreen).

userStories.title: Fix X Button on Compose Screen
userStories.description: As a user, I want the X button to close the compose message screen so that I can cancel without sending.
acceptanceCriteria: X button in compose screen closes the screen
No message is sent when canceling
userStories.technicalNotes: Likely a navigation issue - ensure the X button calls Navigator.pop() or context.pop().
userStories.notes: Fixed: MainShellWrapper compose button used context.go() instead of context.push(). With go(), the route is replaced rather than pushed, so pop() had nothing to pop back to.

userStories.title: Add Keyboard Dismiss Behavior
userStories.description: As a user, I want to dismiss the keyboard by tapping outside or using a collapse button so that I can see more of the screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping outside input fields dismisses keyboard
Keyboard can be dismissed with a gesture or button
userStories.technicalNotes: Wrap screens in GestureDetector with FocusScope.of(context).unfocus() or use ScrollView with keyboardDismissBehavior.
userStories.notes: Added GestureDetector wrapper with FocusScope.unfocus() to 7 screens: create_message, search, question_detail, login, register, profile, change_password.

userStories.title: Fix Archived Sessions Back Navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want the back button on archived sessions to return to the sessions list so that navigation feels consistent.
acceptanceCriteria: Back button from archived session goes to sessions list, not home
Navigation stack is preserved correctly
userStories.technicalNotes: Check go_router configuration for archived sessions route.
userStories.notes: Fixed: Changed archived sessions back button to go to /sessions. Updated all session navigation to use push() instead of go(). Session detail back button now uses pop() with fallback.

userStories.title: Add Help/Feedback Icon
userStories.description: As a user, I want a help/feedback option so that I can report issues or get assistance.
acceptanceCriteria: Help icon (?) visible in app header or settings
Tapping opens feedback form or links to GitHub issues
userStories.technicalNotes: Could link to GitHub issues page or open email compose with support address.
